cohort: The study included 97 pregnant patients with macrosomic fetuses, predominantly aged 30-45 years, 37-40 weeks pregnant, and multigravidas.
finding: The study concluded that the frequency of maternal intrapartum complications of macrosomic fetuses is high, with 35 complications found among 100 patients.
mod_finding: Caesarean section (26%) and instrumental delivery (6%) were reported as maternal intrapartum complications in patients with macrosomic fetuses.
